item.title: Facile Polyiodides Conversion Enabled by Facet Engineering for Durable Zinc–Iodine Batteries

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in dual-facet spinel Co3O4 that decouples polyiodide confinement from solid-iodine desorption via controlled (100)/(111) facet exposure, overcoming the thermodynamic trade-off of uniform catalysts. Significance: this enables durable Zn–I2 batteries with 161.1 mAh g–1 at 16 A g–1, 0.00055% decay per cycle over 50,000 cycles, and wide −30 to 60 °C operation, advancing practical aqueous iodine storage.

item.title: Sulfur-Induced Local Structure Reconstruction and Weak Na–Anion Interactions Enable Fast Na+ Transport in x Na2S-TaCl5 Electrolytes
item.description:

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Sulfur incorporation reconstructs Ta-polyhedral connectivity in amorphous xNa2S-TaCl5 electrolytes, creating coexisting edge- and corner-sharing motifs and weakening Na–anion binding. This lowers Na+ migration barriers, enabling 3.25 mS cm–1 conductivity (0.28 eV activation) and stable all-solid-state Na batteries with uncoated cathodes (82.6% retention after 100 cycles).

item.description:

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a molecule-crowding strategy using Zn(TFA)2/NaTFA to create anion-rich nanoclustered solvation, shifting water-rich coordination to contact ion pairs and multi-ion nanoclusters. This reduces water activity, suppressing hydrogen evolution and corrosion while enabling uniform Zn deposition. Significance: exceptional stability—Zn||Zn over 2100 h, Zn||Cu 3000 h at 99.4% efficiency, and 82.4% retention after 30,000 cycles.
